description: This Kotlin source file defines dimensional tokens for a TV user interface, including a data class for various UI spacing, radii, focus ring, margins, and progress bar sizes. It provides a default set of dimensions and utility accessors for composition in a Jetpack Compose environment.

classes.name: TvDimens
classes.description: Immutable data class holding dimensional tokens used for UI layout such as spacing, radii, focus ring dimensions, margins, and progress bar sizes.

methods.name: StreamlyDimens.default
methods.description: Accessor that returns the default set of dimensions defined in DefaultTvDimens.
